about: GDP implicit price deflator (Index, 2017 = 100), annual: BEA's NIPA Table 1.1.9 line as EIA's Short-Term Energy Outlook carries it (series GDPDIUS). The forecast tool works in 2025 dollars: a figure of year y is multiplied by index(2025) / index(y). 2026 is EIA's projection and is not used.
source: U.S. Energy Information Administration, Short-Term Energy Outlook, API v2 steo/data, series GDPDIUS (annual)
